$comment: Shared by every actor class. Row fields and attributes are declared (and validated) in spec/schema/row.schema.json; topics and audiences in spec/topics.json. A class file adds its own powers, verbs, attribution rule, class-specific attributes and profile blocks.

attributes.topic: Primary policy domain: an id from spec/topics.json
attributes.subtopic: Nuance within the primary topic: one or more of that topic's subtopics in spec/topics.json
attributes.also: Secondary policy domains the row also touches (ids from spec/topics.json)
attributes.stance: Position on the primary topic, read against its poles in spec/topics.json: -2 strongly restrict ... +2 strongly accelerate. Requires topic.
attributes.audience: Who it was aimed at: an id from spec/topics.json audiences
attributes.venue: Where it was said or done (event, outlet, filing type)
attributes.target: Who or what the act hits (firm, sector, country, product)
attributes.after_gate: true when the act came right after a gate opened (e.g. a launch on the day of an approval)
attributes.gate_ref: Row id of the gate decision; only with after_gate
attributes.rule_ref: Row id of the instrument the act was taken under
